reviews.text: Thanks for the 5 ⭐️ Mr Keithley!!
Prices are reasonable. The doctors and staff are knowledgeable, friendly and take good care of our fur babies.
Thanks !

My senior dog had dental services. They were cautious and alleviated my worries about anesthesia. Follow up instructions were easy to follow. All round great experience. The staff is warm and knowledgeable.
Thanks for the 5 stars ⭐️Jade!! Thank you for choosing Veterans Memorial Drive Animal Hospital.
We appreciate the 5 stars ⭐️ Janine. Thank you for choosing Veterans Memorial Drive Animal Hospital.
Dr.ayala is the best

I brought in a stray i picked up and her 5 kittens.

The Good:
The cost.  They were very fair.  All cats got checked and they got dewormer and probiotics.  Fecal exams were performed.
The cost was around 120 and it included the meds.
Instructions were very clear and first batch of meds weere handled by the vet staff.

The Bad:
The wait was  kinda long but this wasnt a huge deal for me.  The walls are very thin so you can hear almost every word of what every vet  staff person says.
They seem to have a very positive work environment and seem to get along well, so it wasn't a bad thing- it was kinda nice.

All in all, I really liked this place and thought they deserved a good review.
My fur baby has been here several times over the years and I trust him with their care !! Very friendly staff !!

This vet practice is one of the very few places in and around Houston where you can get adjuvant free (aluminum free) DAP (core vaccines) and rabies vaccine.  Because of this Dr. Knapp and staff are highly regarded, appreciated and recommended.
I love this clinic! The vets are the kindest and most caring and the staff is above the top wonderful and obviously love animals. It is a great place to go. Very understanding and smart.
Great repairs service
Very helpful and great care
Thank You!!
Staff is always friendly and patient. I feel very comfortable asking questions.
I was extremely pleased with the service provided by staff and vet.

My dog has been going to Veteran's Memorial Animal Hospital Clinic for rehab since January. Dr. Green and Courtney are the rehab Vet and tech. They are both FANTASTIC and care for my pup like one of their own. She is calm around them and love them.She also sees Dr. Knapp for her non rehab related issues. Dr. Knapp is also one of "her people" she has chosen. She perks up whenever she sees her. The whole team there is great and I appreciate their attention to detail and responsiveness with regards to my girls care. Dr. Knapp even took care of my baby boy who passed away at 13 years old three years back. Her treatments with the acupuncture and laser helped him not to suffer.
Lastly I cannot say enough about rehab with Dr. Green and Courtney! That "Under water treadmill " is a game changer!
Great service doctor and techs and reception all very helpful and knowledgeable

Everyone at this facility was super friendly and made sure Deja Mae was happy and loved!  Courtney was awesome with updates and the rehab work with Deja Mae.  We are super lucky to have found this gem as an alternative to surgery!

We absolutely adore Courtney & Dr. Green!!! Micah has been thriving with water therapy & laser treatment (he is a 9yr old giant breed!). This helicopter mama is so thankful for their support and love. Micah was a VERY nervous boy and everyone took the time to make sure he felt comfortable. He now races into the room, walks around like he owns it, and walks into the treadmill without any issues. We have been to several therapy clinics and I promise if you meet Courtney & Dr. Green you will become loyal clients.
